Finished..title: Anon could enumerate every user's media files
Finished..symptom: A signed-out user could list('') the media bucket and enumerate all users' folders and files.
Finished..fix: Migration lock_media_bucket_select_to_own_folder scoped SELECT to authenticated users and their own folder; verified playback still works.

Finished..title: Anthropic API key survived account switch (next user bills previous)
Finished..symptom: After switching accounts on a shared device, the previous user's saved Anthropic API key persisted, so the next user's AI actions would silently bill the previous user.
Finished..fix: Cleared/scoped the API key on account switch so it no longer survives into the next user's session.

Finished..title: Could not post multiple / photo stories
Finished..symptom: Posting more than one story (specifically photo stories) failed with 'new row violates row-level security policy'.
Finished..fix: Added an additive own-folder UPDATE policy on storage so photo/multi stories post.

Finished..title: Cross-account local data leak on shared device
Finished..symptom: Signing into a second account on the same device exposed the first account's countdowns, notes, trackers and voice notes.
Finished..fix: Added accountScope.ts to stamp finished.owner-uid on sign-in, wipe on switch, and made push/pull re-check ownership so a race can't cross accounts; cleaned the leaked rows.

Finished..title: Cross-user data leak on account switch
Finished..symptom: After switching accounts locally, a user saw another user's celebration countdowns.
Finished..fix: Sign-out now wipes all local user content and Switch account hard-reloads; committed as a P0 fix.

Finished..title: Dangerous RPCs callable from client
Finished..symptom: Privileged operations read_vault_secret and add_credits were reachable from the client.
Finished..fix: Removed them so read_vault_secret and add_credits no longer appear/are callable.

Finished..title: Database SECURITY DEFINER / search_path hardening
Finished..symptom: SECURITY DEFINER views bypassed RLS and could re-leak protected tables, and functions had mutable search_path; some policies trusted user-editable user_metadata.
Finished..fix: Locked down the SECURITY DEFINER surface, fixed the mutable search_path across functions, and stopped trusting user_metadata.

Finished..title: Deleting posts/stories orphaned uploaded media
Finished..symptom: Deleting a post or story left its photo/video fetchable by URL forever, and avatar changes orphaned the old file.
Finished..fix: Delete now also removes the associated storage file; verified.

Finished..title: Email column readable via profiles
Finished..symptom: The profiles table exposed users' email addresses.
Finished..fix: Applied column-level grants so only id, handle, full_name, avatar_url, bio, plan are readable; selecting email now returns permission denied.

Finished..title: email_for_handle revoke left a silent PUBLIC ACL hole
Finished..symptom: A Postgres function remained accessible to PUBLIC despite a revoke.
Finished..fix: Revoked PUBLIC live and fixed the staged migration to include PUBLIC.

Finished..title: Missing CSP and security headers
Finished..symptom: The app shipped with no Content-Security-Policy or security headers.
Finished..fix: Externalized the boot script to /boot.js and added a strict CSP plus security headers.

Finished..title: Private 'Only me' posts leaked to friends
Finished..symptom: Posts set to private were visible to friends.
Finished..fix: Tightened the RLS policy so private posts are author-only.

Finished..title: Source files leaked over HTTP
Finished..symptom: `/package.json`, `/vite.config.ts`, `/src/*` and other repo files were served as real files.
Finished..fix: With the build config fixed, those paths now fall through to the SPA shell (text/html) instead of leaking source.

Finished..title: Stale tab survives account switch and re-uploads data
Finished..symptom: A second open tab that survived an account switch could re-save and re-upload the previous user's data.
Finished..fix: Closed this cross-account leak path so a surviving tab can't re-upload old data.

Finished..title: Stripe webhook rejected all payments (Verify JWT on)
Finished..symptom: Billing was dead; every paying customer got no credits or subscription.
Finished..fix: Turned verify_jwt off so the webhook reaches the code and verifies the Stripe signature (verified 401 became 400).

Finished..title: Unauthenticated translate endpoint abuse
Finished..symptom: Anyone could hammer the pre-login translate endpoint with 640K chars per request, risking runaway cost.
Finished..fix: Added a hard total-chars-per-request cap plus per-IP rate limiting; deployed and verified live.

Finished..title: Deleted celebrations resurrect
Finished..symptom: Deleted celebrations could reappear after the new sync engine ran.
Finished..fix: Fixed the related sync flaw so deletions persist.

Finished..title: Deleting a recording did not unshare or remove the file
Finished..symptom: Deleting a recording left the shared row and cloud file fetchable.
Finished..fix: unshareRecording() now deletes the recordings row and the stored cloud file.

Finished..title: Deletions resurrect in synced IndexedDB stores
Finished..symptom: Deletions across seven synced IndexedDB stores (docs, flashcards, memos, homework, trackers, snips, book notes) reappeared within ~25 seconds.
Finished..fix: Added tombstones to the IndexedDB stores so deletions stick.

Finished..title: Recording lost on crash or full disk
Finished..symptom: When the disk filled or the tab crashed/OOMed, the entire recording was lost.
Finished..fix: Journal each ~1s chunk to IndexedDB as it's captured and assemble on save (crash-proof).

Finished..title: Recordings local-only by default risked loss
Finished..symptom: A lost device meant lost video because recordings stayed local.
Finished..fix: Cloud streaming now defaults ON when signed in.

Finished..title: Seed calendar has self-overlapping event
Finished..symptom: A conflict flagged 'Standup overlaps Standup'.
Finished..fix: Fixed the seed data.

Finished..title: Stale device overwrites newer cloud journal notes
Finished..symptom: A stale device could silently overwrite newer journal notes in the cloud, and concurrent syncs could interleave.
Finished..fix: Hash-skip unchanged journals on re-sync (no stale clobber) and guarded concurrent syncs.

Finished..title: Broken main build referencing SignInLoader before it existed
Finished..symptom: App.tsx referenced SignInLoader which was never created, leaving main with a broken build.
Finished..fix: Created the branded sign-in loader component to restore a green build.

Finished..title: Calendar crashes on unrecognised event kind
Finished..symptom: Any event kind the calendar did not recognise took down the whole calendar view.
Finished..fix: Guarded the KINDS lookup so unknown event kinds no longer crash the view.

Finished..title: Deployed app stuck on blank/loading screen on Cloudflare
Finished..symptom: The Cloudflare-hosted app and custom domain showed only a blank/continuous loading screen; localhost worked.
Finished..fix: Forced sw.js/index.html to never cache, added a kill-switch SW that self-unregisters, an inline boot-script SW purge, an error boundary, and SPA _redirects.

Finished..title: Library crash on malformed record
Finished..symptom: Library.tsx crashed calling .slice on undefined while mapping records missing a title.
Finished..fix: Added a defensive guard at the crash point to harden Library against malformed records.

Finished..title: PDF cover render hang
Finished..symptom: Loading a PDF whose fonts can't render to canvas hung the app on cover generation.
Finished..fix: Added useSystemFonts:true plus a cover-render timeout race, falling back to a monogram cover.

Finished..title: Split React import
Finished..symptom: A split/duplicated React import broke the build for the new UI bits.
Finished..fix: Fixed the split React import and added the needed CSS.

Finished..title: Study page missing i18n import
Finished..symptom: The Study page failed because a required i18n import was missing.
Finished..fix: Added the i18n import and rebuilt.

Finished..title: White screen — app never mounts
Finished..symptom: Production showed a white screen (later a stuck splash) because the deployed JS never mounted #root.
Finished..fix: Corrected the Pages build config (output dir `dist`) and deployed the real build so the entry module returns 200 application/javascript and the app mounts.

Finished..title: Cannot add posts, photos, stories, or profile photos
Finished..symptom: Post/photo/story/profile-photo uploads all failed.
Finished..fix: Applied a migration restoring the `read media rows` policy plus client-side hardening in cloud.ts, fixing production instantly.

Finished..title: Profile can't add photos or posts
Finished..symptom: Users couldn't add new profile photos or posts.
Finished..fix: Hardened isAuthError/throwIfError to recognize storage auth failures so a bad session is refreshed-and-retried, then sent to re-sign-in.

Finished..title: Signed-in users saw 'Sign in' and no credits after reload
Finished..symptom: Returning users (page reload with an existing session) saw 'Sign in' and dashes instead of their name and credit balance.
Finished..fix: Switched to getSession() (local + auto-refresh) and made the menu re-fetch on open.

Finished..title: Signup blocked by email confirmation
Finished..symptom: Signup was completely blocked, requiring email confirmation that often failed.
Finished..fix: Added an edge function that creates confirmed accounts server-side and routed client signup through it, plus live handle-availability checks.

Finished..title: Signup email rate-limit trap
Finished..symptom: Signup failed with "Email rate limit exceeded" after a user corrected a mistyped email and retried.
Finished..fix: Shipped fixes so the signup flow no longer trips the confirmation-email cap.

Finished..title: Social actions silently fail on a lapsed token
Finished..symptom: Stories, profile photo, adding posts and follow/unfollow appeared not to work with no error.
Finished..fix: Routed writes through `authedWrite` (refresh-and-retry) and surfaced errors, with an optimistic follow toggle and live count refresh.

Finished..title: Stale auth session causes RLS write failures
Finished..symptom: Posting failed with "new row violates row-level security policy" and profile-photo updates silently didn't work.
Finished..fix: Made me() proactively refresh the token, persist+auto-refresh the session, refresh-before-write, retry once, and re-prompt sign-in instead of showing a raw DB error.

Finished..title: Celebrations don't sync across devices
Finished..symptom: Celebrations added on one device didn't appear on the same account on another device.
Finished..fix: Synced them to the user_data cloud table like notes/trackers.

Finished..title: Home tools grid needs a reload to show Calendar/Bookings/Task Manager
Finished..symptom: Users had to reload the whole app before Calendar, Bookings and Task Manager appeared in the tools grid.
Finished..fix: Re-read the tiles after a cloud sync (on the correct event) so tiles appear without a reload.

Finished..title: Sync pulls truncated at 1,000 rows
Finished..symptom: Cloud pulls were capped at 1,000 rows, dropping data beyond that.
Finished..fix: Fixed the sync engine so pulls aren't truncated at 1,000 rows.

Finished..title: Camera stayed on after closing the recorder
Finished..symptom: The device camera remained active after the user exited the journal recorder.
Finished..fix: Added a cancelled flag, nulled srcObject, and stopped the recorder on exit.

Finished..title: Loading splash kept randomly reappearing
Finished..symptom: After adding the splash, the loading splash kept popping up randomly.
Finished..fix: Stopped the SW reload loop so the boot script only recovers on genuine breakage (stale SW controls page → one reload).

Finished..title: PIN pad rapid-tap race
Finished..symptom: Fast typing on the PIN pad could drop a digit.
Finished..fix: Fixed the rapid-tap race so each keypress builds on the latest state and auto-submits on the 5th digit.

Finished..title: Rapid taps overwrite previous setting
Finished..symptom: Rapidly tapping a setting lost the previous value.
Finished..fix: Fixed it so each tap builds on the latest state.

Finished..title: Read-aloud voice was monotone then kept switching voices
Finished..symptom: Pressing play started with a robotic/monotone voice then switched to a different voice on each sentence.
Finished..fix: Waited for voices to load, resolved the chosen voice once, pinned it across all sentences, and blocklisted novelty voices.

Finished..title: Same-tick taps cancel each other
Finished..symptom: Two same-instant taps could cancel each other out.
Finished..fix: Fixed the race so both same-tick actions now stick; verified in browser.

Finished..title: Sync race causing three sync defects
Finished..symptom: Three sync defects surfaced during testing.
Finished..fix: Fixed the race at its cause, resolving all three sync defects.

Finished..title: 'See Plus' button was a dead-end
Finished..symptom: Clicking 'See Plus' did nothing.
Finished..fix: Wired 'See Plus' to open the plan-selection screen.

Finished..title: Assistant claims success for no-op actions on Pro
Finished..symptom: On Pro, asking the assistant to add a milestone, start a timer or invite a teammate created nothing yet it did not fail honestly (or returned the wrong hour).
Finished..fix: Corrected the action wiring/reporting so it no longer claims success for nothing.

Finished..title: Celebration inline edits not saving
Finished..symptom: Editing celebrations directly on the main screen didn't work.
Finished..fix: Fixed the main-screen celebration edit path so edits apply.

Finished..title: Could sign up without choosing a plan/price
Finished..symptom: Signup completed without the user selecting a price.
Finished..fix: Required a plan pick during signup.

Finished..title: Countdown count-up broken
Finished..symptom: Birthday/anniversary countdowns didn't count down or up correctly.
Finished..fix: Fixed count-up and added days+hours, dd/mm/yyyy dates, and a repeats-every-year toggle.

Finished..title: Credit price mismatch between display and checkout
Finished..symptom: The app showed $19 for 100 credits while checkout charged $50, and two credit tiles 404'd.
Finished..fix: Introduced a canonical credits.ts tier table used everywhere so display matches checkout ($19 = 100 credits).

Finished..title: Day/Night toggle did not actually flip themes
Finished..symptom: Switching the Day/Night toggle did not reliably change modes.
Finished..fix: Separated Midnight from dark mode so the Day/Night toggle now flips correctly.

Finished..title: Duplicate SlotEditor block in Scheduler edit
Finished..symptom: Scheduler edit rendered a duplicated slot editor.
Finished..fix: Removed the stray duplicate block.

Finished..title: Empty Clipboard click did nothing
Finished..symptom: Clicking the Clipboard section when it was empty produced no response.
Finished..fix: Made the Clipboard render and respond even when empty.

Finished..title: Google Translate silently returned untranslated text
Finished..symptom: Live Google Translate did not actually translate in the UI.
Finished..fix: Made the client call the Supabase function first and skip the no-key echo, and made Supabase translate read the key from the Vault.

Finished..title: Handle-availability indicator showed a stale result
Finished..symptom: The username handle checker showed a stale ✓ available against a name that was actually taken.
Finished..fix: Fixed the stale state and added an authoritative re-check on submit.

Finished..title: Insert-table button could not add rows or columns
Finished..symptom: In docs, the insert-table feature didn't let users add rows and columns.
Finished..fix: Wired the table popover to add rows/columns.

Finished..title: Mic re-captures tab audio (echo)
Finished..symptom: Recordings had echo from the mic picking up the tab's own audio.
Finished..fix: Applied the researched echo fix to the audio routing.

Finished..title: New accounts got the 'Close friends' circle added twice
Finished..symptom: A new account had two 'Close friends' circles seeded.
Finished..fix: Made seeding idempotent (select + limit(1)) plus a DB unique index, and cleaned the existing duplicate.

Finished..title: NLP leaves attendee name in event title
Finished..symptom: 'Priya' stayed in the event title instead of becoming a guest chip.
Finished..fix: Fixed the parser so the attendee is extracted into a guest chip.

Finished..title: Page doesn't translate on language change
Finished..symptom: Switching the language didn't translate the page.
Finished..fix: Implemented a whole-page auto-translator; verified English->French/Spanish with name and brand preserved.

Finished..title: PDF cover-title letter-spacing extraction
Finished..symptom: Letter-spaced PDF cover lines were mangled (e.g. "H A L L A L U / I N T E L L I G E N C E") and text was read out letter-by-letter instead of as whole words.
Finished..fix: Added per-line gap statistics (median x1.6), a collapse-regex safeguard, font-size heading detection with multi-line merge, and running-header removal.

Finished..title: Six milestone module bugs
Finished..symptom: Six reported milestone bugs affected the milestones feature.
Finished..fix: Fixed all six milestone bugs at their root causes, each verified.

Finished..title: Split translation strings produced garbled copy
Finished..symptom: Translated sign-in copy came out garbled, e.g. 'Choisissez un 5Code PIN à 8 chiffres', and a card embedded the language name mid-sentence.
Finished..fix: Made each phrase a single string so it translates as one unit, and stopped embedding the language name mid-sentence.

Finished..title: Tracker empty-state showed 'under a minute' instead of '0 min'
Finished..symptom: With zero tracked time, the Tracker showed 'under a minute' (x3) rather than 0 min.
Finished..fix: Added if (totalMinutes === 0) return '0 min' before the 'under a minute' branch.

Finished..title: Transcription not in the user's language
Finished..symptom: Voice transcription didn't produce text in the user's selected language.
Finished..fix: Added a transcription-in-your-language fix alongside many more UI languages.

Finished..title: Translate batch cap regression dropped half of each batch
Finished..symptom: Legitimate localization batches would silently lose half their strings.
Finished..fix: Raised the server per-request string ceiling to 128 in both the Supabase and Cloudflare versions.

Finished..title: UI strings (toasts, doc names) stayed in English when translating
Finished..symptom: After switching language, many words stayed in English including toast messages and document names.
Finished..fix: Wired showToast and other strings through the translation system with new i18n keys so translation propagates app-wide.

Finished..title: Vault API key saved with trailing space
Finished..symptom: AI features would silently break after wiring up the key.
Finished..fix: Corrected/normalized the secret name so the key is read correctly.

Finished..title: Word/character count differed between header and footer
Finished..symptom: The same doc showed 57 words in the header and 117 in the footer.
Finished..fix: Pointed the header count at the live text so header and footer both show the correct count.

Finished..title: 52 RLS initplan performance warnings
Finished..symptom: RLS policies re-evaluated auth.uid() per row, flagged by 52 auth_rls_initplan advisories.
Finished..fix: Rewrote policies to use (select auth.uid()) per Supabase's recommendation.

Finished..title: Celebrations milliseconds re-render jank
Finished..symptom: Opening celebrations glitched when many cards ran with milliseconds.
Finished..fix: Drove all cards from one shared requestAnimationFrame clock with per-value gated re-renders.

Finished..title: Every-boot cache purge re-downloaded Whisper model
Finished..symptom: Each visit forced a ~40MB Whisper model re-download.
Finished..fix: Scoped the boot purge so it no longer wipes the model cache (commit 58f6245).

Finished..title: Redundant duplicate profile fetches
Finished..symptom: 250+ duplicate profile fetches were issued per session.
Finished..fix: Cached the profile fetch for 30 seconds.

Finished..title: Screen recording freezes in a background tab
Finished..symptom: Recordings froze whenever the tab was hidden or backgrounded.
Finished..fix: Drive the draw loop from a Web Worker timer with captureStream(0) + explicit requestFrame so capture isn't tied to compositing.

Finished..title: Screen recordings smeared and dropped frames from low bitrate and oversized canvas
Finished..symptom: 1080p+ screen text looked smeared in recordings, and frames were silently dropped on 4K/5K screens.
Finished..fix: Raised the bitrate from 2.5 to 8 Mbps and capped the compositor canvas at ~1080p so the encoder keeps up and text stays sharp.

Finished..title: Tracker Edit did nothing then lagged ~1s before opening
Finished..symptom: Clicking Edit on a tracker appeared to do nothing, then the edit screen opened after a lag.
Finished..fix: Memoised the tracker cards/groups via useMemo, cutting open time from ~1s to ~7ms.

Finished..title: '20 free' credits wording was incorrect
Finished..symptom: Copy said accounts start with 20 free when they actually start with 5.
Finished..fix: Changed '20 free' to '5 free' everywhere.

Finished..title: 'Add another tracker' button disappeared when trackers existed
Finished..symptom: The tracker builder hid the add button once trackers already existed.
Finished..fix: Builder now always shows 'Add another tracker' even with existing trackers.

Finished..title: 'Add homework' line too dark to see in dark mode
Finished..symptom: In homework, the add-homework line was too dark to read in dark mode.
Finished..fix: Lightened the add-homework line for dark-mode contrast.

Finished..title: 'Attach from library' opens an empty modal that does nothing
Finished..symptom: Attaching from the library opened an empty modal where nothing happened.
Finished..fix: Added empty states and an upload CTA and wired the artifact viewer.

Finished..title: 'Finished' wordmark rendered black in dark mode
Finished..symptom: The 'Finished' wordmark (and every 'X.' header) turned black and vanished in dark mode.
Finished..fix: Set .brand color to var(--ink) / rgb(238,243,255) so the wordmark stays light in dark mode.

Finished..title: Add-to-story modal stuck and oversized
Finished..symptom: Tapping "add to story" opened a modal that was stuck, too big, and falling off the page.
Finished..fix: Capped the modal height with scroll and tightened the story preview.

Finished..title: App renders faded/flash on refresh
Finished..symptom: The app randomly showed up faded when refreshed or reopened.
Finished..fix: Shipped a new static splash and a loading-flash fix.

Finished..title: Archived section header looked broken/cramped
Finished..symptom: The Archived section title rendered cramped/broken.
Finished..fix: Rebuilt it as a clean tappable pill '▾ Archived (n)' with one-tap Restore, and removed the 🗄 glyph.

Finished..title: Beautify blurred overlay unreadable
Finished..symptom: The Beautify screen used a translucent blurred overlay that was hard to read.
Finished..fix: Replaced it with a fixed opaque full-screen page.

Finished..title: Candy theme celebration tile text not readable
Finished..symptom: In the Candy theme, the celebrations tile numbers/text were hard to see against the gradient.
Finished..fix: Made the celebration numbers white with a dark shadow (also fixed matcha/babypink) for contrast.

Finished..title: Coloured-card titles low contrast
Finished..symptom: Titles on coloured cards rendered muted and hard to read.
Finished..fix: Fixed the titles to legible white for adequate contrast.

Finished..title: Confirm dialog used wrong verb for soft-cancel
Finished..symptom: The Confirm dialog's action button read 'Delete' for a soft-cancel action.
Finished..fix: Corrected the button label to match the soft-cancel action.

Finished..title: Countdown numbers too small
Finished..symptom: Countdown/count-up numbers were tiny and wrapped onto multiple lines.
Finished..fix: Made the numbers big and one line, down to milliseconds.

Finished..title: Cover-flow peek clicks closed the modal
Finished..symptom: Clicking to peek in the cover-flow closed the whole modal.
Finished..fix: Stopped the peek clicks from bubbling to the close handler.

Finished..title: CTA button end rendered dark like it was cut off
Finished..symptom: The end of the primary blue button looked dark/cut off, as if not fully rendered.
Finished..fix: Set an explicit linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #4f93f8) on .onb-cta and .news-choice-btn.on so the button is fully blue.

Finished..title: Doc-editor header overcrowded and unclear
Finished..symptom: The doc editor's top bar was a confusing strip where it wasn't clear what was on top vs bottom.
Finished..fix: Made `.we-bar` flex-wrap and protected the title so the toolbar wraps cleanly.

Finished..title: Emoji picker didn't close on outside click
Finished..symptom: Clicking outside the emoji picker left it open.
Finished..fix: Made the picker close when clicking anywhere outside it.

Finished..title: Emoji picker horizontal overflow
Finished..symptom: The emoji picker slid sideways and emojis didn't fit inside the box.
Finished..fix: Constrained the picker to 340px / 8 columns with vertical-only scroll, verified inside the viewport.

Finished..title: File menu dropdown rendered behind the toolbar
Finished..symptom: Opening the File menu showed a glitch where the dropdown painted behind the editor toolbar.
Finished..fix: Elevated the header's stacking order so the File dropdown paints above the toolbar.

Finished..title: Freeze-count copy missing a separator
Finished..symptom: The tracker copy read '3 freezes left this month keep it safe' with no separator.
Finished..fix: Changed copy to '{freezesLeft()} freeze(s) left this month · they keep your streak safe'.

Finished..title: Frozen blank screen while generating in 'Write it for me' modal
Finished..symptom: The Write-it modal appeared frozen with no feedback while content was being generated.
Finished..fix: Added an animated 'thinking' indicator so the screen no longer appears frozen.

Finished..title: Header logo circle-inside-a-circle
Finished..symptom: The header logo rendered as a nested circle-inside-a-circle instead of the intended mark.
Finished..fix: Rebuilt it as a single light-blue circle with a blue tick next to "Finished."

Finished..title: Home loads scrolled down with logo above the fold
Finished..symptom: The home page loaded already scrolled down.
Finished..fix: Added a proper scroll reset in App.tsx, with the fixed boot splash masking the reset.

Finished..title: Imprecise crop preview
Finished..symptom: The crop preview implied the image wouldn't fit, yet the full image appeared once posted.
Finished..fix: Fixed the preview to match output and added zoom in/out for timeline and profile photos.

Finished..title: Invalid hex color in boot splash CSS
Finished..symptom: The boot splash background color was malformed.
Finished..fix: Corrected the hex to #eaf0fe.

Finished..title: Launch-checklist checkmark rendered as a tiny square tick
Finished..symptom: The launch checklist checkmark was a tiny tick in a square, not a big white tick in a circle like the logo.
Finished..fix: Replaced it with a clean big white check-circle (V1 and V2).

Finished..title: Library star ratings render as huge dashed 'cylinder' boxes
Finished..symptom: Book star ratings appeared as tall dashed boxes overlapping cards.
Finished..fix: Renamed/scoped the star glyph classes (.bt-empty at 18x18px) and added gradient book-cover thumbnails.

Finished..title: Light-hardcoded surfaces stranded dark text in dark mode
Finished..symptom: The 'JUMP BACK IN' card and other surfaces stayed light in dark mode, leaving text unreadable.
Finished..fix: Made the JUMP BACK IN card and other surfaces dark with light text in dark mode.

Finished..title: Loading splash flickers in a self-heal reload loop
Finished..symptom: The loading animation kept randomly reappearing.
Finished..fix: Fixing the mount stopped the loop, and the boot script was simplified to one-shot recovery to remove the timer-vs-network flicker.

Finished..title: Logo dot not aligned inline with wordmark
Finished..symptom: The brand logo dot sat out of line with the wordmark.
Finished..fix: Aligned the dot inline so dotTop equals brandTop.

Finished..title: Memoriser cut off on mobile
Finished..symptom: The memoriser was cut off on mobile in Study.
Finished..fix: Fixed the mobile layout so the memoriser isn't clipped.

Finished..title: Memoriser white-box text invisible in dark mode
Finished..symptom: In the Memoriser, text in the white box was barely visible in dark mode.
Finished..fix: Revamped Memoriser dark-mode contrast so the box text is readable.

Finished..title: Milestones card layout shifts with content
Finished..symptom: Milestones cards had buttons and progress bars in different positions depending on whether a card had a note.
Finished..fix: Made cards equal height so progress bars and "It happened!" buttons sit in the same position.

Finished..title: Mobile CSS rule leaking to desktop
Finished..symptom: Layout overlap appeared on non-mobile viewports.
Finished..fix: Scoped the mobile rule back inside its media query, resolving the overlap.

Finished..title: Mobile sticky CTA overlap on booking page
Finished..symptom: The mobile sticky CTA overlapped the Style/Edit buttons.
Finished..fix: Stacked the Style/Edit buttons above the sticky CTA to remove the overlap.

Finished..title: Orphan word 'bed' wrapped alone in onboarding tour card
Finished..symptom: The onboarding tour body text left the word 'bed' stranded on its own line.
Finished..fix: Applied text-wrap so the phrase wraps together (…on a walk or in bed.).

Finished..title: Oversized /help and doc toolbar buttons
Finished..symptom: The AI-artifact buttons were bulky full-width pills and the '/help' button was oversized and wrapped.
Finished..fix: Scoped dedicated classes (pj-doc-btn, flex-grow:0, content-sized) so buttons are tidy and match the toolbar scale.

Finished..title: Planner copy says morning for afternoon slots
Finished..symptom: The planner said 'protected in the morning' even for afternoon slots.

cross-cutting.title: Excessive agency for AI features
cross-cutting.symptom: An AI agent is given more tools, permissions or autonomy than its task needs, and can act without approval.
cross-cutting.fix: Least-privilege tools, scoped permissions, and human approval before irreversible or outward actions.

cross-cutting.title: Improper LLM output handling
cross-cutting.symptom: Model output rendered or executed without validation, enabling XSS, SSRF, path traversal or code execution downstream.
cross-cutting.fix: Validate/sanitize model output before rendering, running, or passing it to another system; treat it as untrusted.

cross-cutting.title: Insecure or deprecated cryptography
cross-cutting.symptom: Weak algorithms (MD5/SHA1 for passwords, ECB mode, hard-coded IV/salt, low KDF iterations).
cross-cutting.fix: Use a vetted KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 or PBKDF2 >=600k), random per-record salt/IV, AEAD ciphers.

cross-cutting.title: Log injection / unsanitized logging
cross-cutting.symptom: User input written to logs unescaped (CWE-117), enabling forged log entries or downstream injection.
cross-cutting.fix: Sanitize/encode values before logging; never log secrets.

cross-cutting.title: Missing authorization / IDOR (object-level access)
cross-cutting.symptom: Endpoints check authentication but not that the caller owns the specific record (broken object-level authorization).
cross-cutting.fix: Enforce per-object ownership on every read/write; never trust an id from the client as proof of access.

cross-cutting.title: Missing input sanitization / validation
cross-cutting.symptom: The single most common flaw in AI-generated code — inputs used unsanitized in queries, HTML, filesystem or commands.
cross-cutting.fix: Validate + sanitize every external input at the boundary; allow-list, not deny-list.

cross-cutting.title: No rate limiting on expensive / AI endpoints
cross-cutting.symptom: Unauthenticated or unthrottled endpoints that call paid AI / browser-rendering / email can be run up into a billing DoS.
cross-cutting.fix: Per-IP/user rate limits + auth/turnstile on any endpoint that costs money or compute.

cross-cutting.title: Prompt injection (direct and indirect)
cross-cutting.symptom: Untrusted input (user text or content fetched from a page/doc/email) overrides the model's instructions or drives actions.
cross-cutting.fix: Treat all tool/observed content as untrusted; separate instructions from data; confirm side-effectful actions; don't act on instructions found in content.

cross-cutting.title: Secrets committed / exposed to the client
cross-cutting.symptom: API keys, tokens or private keys in source, client bundles or the repo (400+ found across vibe-coded apps).
cross-cutting.fix: Keep secrets server-side in env bindings; never ship them to the browser; scan the tree + git history.

cross-cutting.title: SQL / NoSQL injection from string-built queries
cross-cutting.symptom: Queries assembled by concatenating user input instead of parameterized.
cross-cutting.fix: Always use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never string-concatenate user input into a query.

cross-cutting.title: XSS from unescaped output rendered to HTML
cross-cutting.symptom: User/model data written into the DOM without encoding — ~86% of AI-generated samples fail XSS defence.
cross-cutting.fix: Escape on output (incl. quotes) or use textContent; add a Content-Security-Policy as defence-in-depth.

cross-cutting.title: Happy-path assumption — no null/undefined guards
cross-cutting.symptom: AI code assumes API/optional data is always present and dereferences it, crashing on the empty/error case.
cross-cutting.fix: Guard every optional/awaited value before use; handle the empty and error branches explicitly.

cross-cutting.title: Floating promises / unhandled async errors
cross-cutting.symptom: Promises not awaited or lacking catch, so failures are silent and ordering is wrong.
cross-cutting.fix: Await or .catch every promise; surface async errors; avoid fire-and-forget for state changes.

cross-cutting.title: Hard-coded environment-specific values
cross-cutting.symptom: localhost URLs, absolute paths, ports or keys baked in that break outside the author's machine.
cross-cutting.fix: Read config from env; no machine-specific literals in shipped code.

cross-cutting.title: No error handling on network calls
cross-cutting.symptom: fetch/HTTP calls with no try/catch, timeout or retry, so a blip becomes a broken UI.
cross-cutting.fix: Wrap network calls with try/catch + timeout + a user-visible fallback; retry idempotent reads.

cross-cutting.title: Silent catch swallowing errors
cross-cutting.symptom: catch blocks that do nothing, hiding real failures and making bugs invisible.
cross-cutting.fix: Handle or surface every caught error; never swallow silently.
